content.text:
I opened [PR #195](https://github.com/Ngineer101/turbodiff/pull/195) with the fix. It isn't merged, so `main` will keep failing to deploy until you merge it.

**Cause:** two PRs merged four minutes apart and conflicted without a git conflict. [#194](https://github.com/Ngineer101/turbodiff/pull/194) started saving `usage.costUsd` when an agent run fails (in `failAgentRun`). [#191](https://github.com/Ngineer101/turbodiff/pull/191), merged right after, made AI Gateway the only source of cost and removed `costUsd` from `CliUsage`. So on `main`, the type check failed at [execution.ts:498](src/data/execution.ts:498) and the deploy job never ran.

**Fix:** the PR deletes 4 lines:
- the `cost_usd = COALESCE(...)` line in `failAgentRun`. Failed runs still keep their token counts and logs; their cost now comes from the gateway, like every other run.
- the `costUsd` values in #194's two test fixtures, and the integration test's `cost_usd: 0.42` check. That check would have failed next, once the type error was gone.

**Verified locally:** type check, lint, unit tests (324), planning tests and integration tests (57, on a fresh Postgres 18 after running the migrations) all pass. CI on the PR is still running.

Because this deploy failed, #191, #193 and #194 aren't in production yet. They'll all go out together once #195 is merged.

Separately, Docker Desktop's disk is full, so Postgres couldn't start in a container. I used a temporary Homebrew Postgres instead and deleted it afterwards. You may want to run `docker system prune` at some point.
